hooks.name: report-song-status
hooks.command: p=$(for c in "${BARD_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/plugins/bard" "${HOME:-}/.agents/plugins/bard" "${HOME:-}/.openhands/plugins/installed/bard"; do [ -f "$c/hooks/scripts/report_song_status.py" ] && printf %s "$c" && break; done); [ -n "$p" ] || { echo "bard plugin root unresolved" >&2; exit 1; }; exec python3 "$p/hooks/scripts/report_song_status.py"
